import ACVFQE
import Section3.Library
import Section4.Library
import Section5.Library

/-!
# Special transformations: section-by-section coordination root

Quantifier elimination is supplied by the pinned independent ACVF-QE package.
The relocated section snapshots are not imported automatically: their proof
status and interfaces must be audited before integration.

Section 4 uses the material in previous sections as given and records its
own compiler and headline checks in Section4/STATUS.md. Its active library
excludes the relocated legacy snapshots.

Section 5 likewise records its explicit accepted earlier inputs and its
separate compiler, headline-type and axiom checks in Section5/STATUS.md.
-/
